content: {"reasoning":"PR-204 indicates the service is simply not covered under the patient's plan, consistent with the noted lapsed eligibility. Auth is not required here, retro-auth and P2P are not offered, and the pairing is already valid, so correcting or resubmitting won't overturn a coverage/eligibility denial. There is no medical-necessity issue to appeal, and as a Medicaid MCO member the patient cannot be balance-billed for a non-covered service. With no payer action able to progress collection, closing the balance is the appropriate resolution.","action":"write_off"}
